title: Echoes in the Theater
description: A woman in a shimmering silver gown sits in a red velvet theater chair, looking upward with her hand raised as swirling ethereal energy emanates from her. Behind her, two translucent ghostly female figures hover, one reaching toward her, while a large movie screen in the background displays an empty vintage cinema filled with film reels.
prompt: A woman in a flowing metallic silver gown sits in an ornate red velvet theater seat, looking up with wonder as swirling translucent energy rings flow from her hands and body. Two ghostly women in vintage dresses float behind her, one reaching out. In the background a large cinema screen shows an empty theater filled with vintage film reels. Dark starry ceiling, dramatic cinematic lighting, surreal atmosphere, detailed painting.
